ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45; high-intensity white patches are localized to the distal tips, while low-intensity black pixels dominate the medial surface areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches occupy the outer 25% of both the left and right lobe tips. The central 50% of the visible fluke surface consists of continuous low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire superior trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks ranges from 3 to 12 pixels relative to local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward trajectory; lobes extend at an approximate 35-degree angle from the central submerged axis toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels observed on the furthest distal edges of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four parallel, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the dark-pigmented region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct rake marks visible on the right lobe medial region; significant irregular fringe wear on the distal-most tips.
